newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO to help run Hanbo for creditors.
newsitem.headline: POSCO to help run Hanbo for creditors.

text.p: South Korea's Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd (POSCO) has formally agreed to help run insolvent Hanbo Steel Co on behalf of Hanbo's creditors, POSCO chairman Kim Mahn-je said on Tuesday.
POSCO said earlier it would try to help rescue Hanbo Steel.
Hanbo Steel, South Korea's second largest steelmaker after POSCO, was declared insolvent on January 23 after it accumulated about five trillion won in loans from 61 banks and financial institutions.
Kim told reporters that POSCO would ask six to seven of its executives to quit the company and run Hanbo Steel, flagship of the Hanbo Group, South Korea's 14th largest conglomerate.
At the request of creditors, POSCO recommended Son Geun-suk, chairman of its unlisted affiliate POSCO Engineering and Construction Co Ltd, to head a management team to run Hanbo Steel, Kim said.
Hanbo Steel has applied for court receivership.
